generation_contract.positive_template: One {body_color} {material} {form_factor} {object_type}, a household {category}: a narrow vertical telephone base with a corded handset seated in its side cradle, a front keypad, and a clearly visible horizontal ringer grille across the lower front of the base.
generation_contract.pose_guard_prompt: Render exactly one object, centered, resting stably on a flat neutral surface against a plain seamless light-gray background. Three-quarter product view from slightly above eye level so the front and one side are both visible. The entire object fits in frame with a clear margin on every side. Physically plausible real-world proportions and construction. Even studio lighting, soft shadow directly beneath the object only. No humans, no hands, no text, no logos, no labels, no screens showing content, no cables trailing out of frame, no reflections of surroundings, no additional objects, no cropping. This is a neutral reconstruction reference for image-to-3D, not an advertisement scene.
generation_contract.negative_prompt: human, hand, fingers, text, logo, watermark, label, sticker, multiple objects, duplicated object, cropped object, cut off, close-up detail shot, extreme perspective, fisheye, tilted camera, floating object, reflection of photographer, cluttered background, background furniture, scene environment, packaging box, advertisement layout, collage, split image, pair of speakers, stereo pair, two speakers, stacked speakers, speaker stand, tripod stand, wall bracket, subwoofer box, amplifier, receiver, turntable, cables, grille cloth over the drivers, removed front panel, exploded view, cutaway, short cabinet, tabletop speaker, single driver, two drivers, horizontal orientation, lying down, desk phone, mobile phone, detached handset, floating handset, wall, room scene, loose cable

reference_provenance.notes: Provisional typical retail dimension; measure the approved mesh before formal registration. Uniform height scaling amplifies any aspect error from reconstruction, so check the width and depth of the finalized mesh as well.
